posts.title: Unstarving the understory
posts.description: tl;dr: Startups designed to reach free cashflow fast and then stay small/medium-sized (we call them fast-to-free-cashflow, or FFCF , startups) have no good way to get funded. Venture capital, private equity, debt, and grants are each the wrong shape for them.
